description_sq:
Shitet Vile ne Rezidencen Olive Grove.
 Vila organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje bashke me kendin e gatimit dhe te ngrenies, 3 dhoma gjumi, njera me garderobe, 3 tualete, 1 ballkon, nje verande si dhe nje oborr teper relaksues qe te ofron nje pamje te lire te Kalase se Petreles.
 Zona karakterizohet per qetesi dhe ajer te paster. 
Rezidenca gjithashtu ofron ambiente te perbashketa multifunksionale si lulishte, hapsire e gjelber per femije, fusha basketbolli, etj. 
Ne cmim perfshihet edhe nje garazh i mbyllur prej 20 m2 si dhe mundesia e parkimit te nje automjeti te dyte. 
Per nje vizite ne prone jeni te mirepritur te na kontaktoni!
description_en: Villa for sale in Olive Grove Residence. The villa is organized in a living room with a kitchen and dining area, 3 bedrooms, one with a wardrobe, 3 bathrooms, 1 balcony, a veranda and a very relaxing yard that offers a clear view of Petrele Castle. The area is characterized by calmness and clean air. The residence also offers multifunctional common facilities such as flower gardens, green space for children, basketball courts, etc. The price includes a closed garage of 20 m2 as well as the possibility of parking a second vehicle. For a visit to the property, you are welcome to contact us!
